name: @visuelconcept-winccoa/wui-users
description: Users — standalone WinCC OA WebUI page (/users): the project's user administration as the WinCC OA panel does it — users (create, edit, enable/disable, password of local users, groups, delete), groups and their 32 permission bits, domains (areas) and per-domain permissions, the permission names, the authentication method (WinCC OA / Active Directory), the import of AD groups and users, and an automatic import of the missing AD users of the AD-linked groups; config/config entries and user settings shown read-only. Every write goes through the vendor's UserManagement classes (CTRL, _CommandChannel) in the usersService JS manager — never a dpSet on _Users — role-gated (Application Security) and audited.

notes: usersService manager: start it with a user that has the user-administration permission (_System.Auth.UserManagement), e.g. `-user <admin>:<password>` in pmon — the commandChannel manager checks that user for every write
settings and last report of the automatic AD import in the DP WuiUsers_Config (created at the manager's start); the import is off until turned on in the page
audit lines go to an _AuditTrail DP, when it exists: auditDp in the [wui-users] section of config/config, else WUI_USERS_AUDIT_DP, else AuditTrail_Users
